artifact_scope: G1 Gazebo V3 diagnostic smoke; retained but excluded from confirmatory efficacy
exclusion_reason: pre-execution planner audit showed trial-order global-costmap contamination; even DynNavShortest changed between direct and detour routes across dependence/order blocks
key_observation: dependence truth is sampled only after route choice, so dependence-block changes in the initial route cannot be interpreted causally and reveal a changing planning cost surface
retained_positive_signal: the pre-execution audit demonstrated that the direct and detour routes are both physically/planner reachable and that the history/robust objectives can separate under at least one frozen costmap realization
next_protocol: V3.1 freezes the global planning costmap to static map plus inflation for all planners while leaving the local sensor costmap unchanged; recovery overlays actually applied blocker footprints on the static global costmap
claim_boundary: V3 must not be used for confirmatory planner superiority, dependence-effect, or irreversible-failure claims
